titulo: In one of the largest deals in tech history, Marvell buys Lumentum for $115B
resumo_original: Marvell's planned purchase of Lumentum is one of the biggest acquisitions in tech history. And they both have the same strategic investor: Nvidia.

titulo: Readwise takes on Amazon’s Kindle and Goodreads with its new app for book lovers
resumo_original: Readwise Books combines an ebook store, reading tracker, detailed reading stats, and AI features in a bid to challenge Amazon's ecosystem.

titulo: SpaceX reportedly wants to buy Boost Mobile to compete with AT&T, T-Mobile, and Verizon
resumo_original: SpaceX has been looking for new ways to use its Starlink network, and a tie-up with cellular operator Boost Mobile could give it the terrestrial access it needs.

titulo: 42AI comes out of stealth with $62.5M and a world model that can ‘predict human behavior’
resumo_original: Here's a question straight out of sci-fi: What if AI could predict what you were going to do before you decided to, even in a completely new situation?

titulo: Elon Musk throttles Grok Bot limits due to ‘unsustainably high’ costs

titulo: Coming in 2027: Apple’s $1,000 home robot for FaceTime and switching on lights
resumo_original: Apple robot backed by CEO John Ternus may have hefty price tag and limited uses.

titulo: Claude’s new rules against game cloning won’t stop the AI copying boom
